{{Quote|Day 12. The Stardream is lost in hyperspace. Infected passengers gather near the ship's radioactive core while the crew readies to stop Captain Magnus and retake control. We will end this.|Lt. Pursal's log aboard the ''Stardream''|<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakghoul Pandemic 1 - The Final Flight of the Stardream}}</ref>}}
'''Pursal''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served aboard the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Stardream]]'' on its final voyage in [[3639 BBY]] when it became infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. In charge of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] log, Pursal recorded the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the ''Stardream'' and its passengers before it crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
Pursal lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Stardream]]''.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> the ''Stardream'' departed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] with 492 civilian passengers under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Magnus (Galactic War)|Magnus]], and Pursal was in charge of maintaining the ship's official log. On the fifth [[Standard day/Legends|day]], food poisoning cases were reported, but by the seventh day the illness&mdash;in actuality the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]&mdash;had spread among the passengers, causing decks 1-5 to be quarantined.<ref name="Codex" />

Two days later, Pursal had become infected as well, and recorded that Magnus had fallen ill and lost his mind as a result, seizing control of the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and sending the ''Stardream'' off course. Three days later, Pursal made a final entry in the log, reporting that the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was lost in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and that the crew was going to attempt to retake the ship from Magnus's control. The ''Stardream'' ultimately crashed on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and Pursal's log was partially reconstructed from the wreckage.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pursal was mentioned in the Codex entry "The Final Flight of the Stardream,"<ref name="Codex" /> part of the [[Rakghoul pandemic|Rakghoul Pandemic]] World Event that was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2012]] with Game Update 1.1.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20120113-0|text=Game Update 1.1: 'Rise of the Rakghouls' Coming Jan. 17th!}}</ref>
